name: codex-account-switcher
description: Switch isolated Codex accounts by relaunching VS Code with a different CODEX_HOME.

codexAccountSwitcher.codexExecutable.description: Codex CLI executable used to authenticate a new profile. Use an absolute path if codex is not on VS Code's PATH.

codexAccountSwitcher.vscodeExecutable.description: Optional VS Code CLI launcher override used for restart. Leave empty to detect the launcher from VS Code's application directory.

codexAccountSwitcher.useDeviceAuth.description: Run `codex login --device-auth` when adding an account.

codexAccountSwitcher.confirmBeforeRestar.description: Ask for confirmation before quitting all VS Code windows and relaunching with the selected account.

codexAccountSwitcher.showEmail.description: Show the email found in local Codex token metadata in the status bar. When disabled, show the profile name.

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run test && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
